lines.name: Harbour Line
lines.beyond: north along Harbour Road past Crown Road; west along Circus Road past Sunset Way. Both termini and the depot are off-sheet and not yet planned

notes: Fix for the rocket-west reach fault: T2 now turns north up Sunset Way instead of leaving south. The rocket-west centroid (-260,-296) is 88 m from the T2 track at x -348, so Vantage can place a Sunset Way stop near y -300, inside the 250 m reach. The same run also passes Lantern West (-260,-563) and Lamplight West (-292,-67). T2 then turns west into Circus Road and leaves the sheet at x -400. It no longer leaves south on Sunset Way below Comet Row.

T-C1 geometry, hand-calculated from the road widths. I have not run the checker. Harbour Road: east carriageway at x 308. Comet Row: south carriageway at y -728. Sunset Way: west carriageway at x -348. Between y -200 and -120 T2 shifts to the east carriageway at x -332 on R300 reverse curves, crossing the 4 m median, which is inside the road width. Circus Road: north carriageway at y 6. Clearances to the inside kerb corners, track centreline / inner track of the double: Harbour/Comet (288,-708) 7.6/5.8 m; Comet/Sunset (-328,-708) 7.6/5.8 m; Sunset/Circus (-352,-9) 3.9/2.1 m. The last one is tight. Splice should check whether T-C1 tests the rails or the vehicle envelope.
T2 stays out of Circus Road's 6 m median, because S1 pylons stand there (S-P2). Its double track at 3.6 m centres (y 4.2 and 7.8) fits the 6 m north carriageway (y 3 to 9). S1 runs 24 m overhead.

N-C1, for Vantage: T2 passes 32 m from the S1 Harbour station (340,0). It crosses T1 at (0,-728) on a flat crossing, about 38 m from T1's Comet Row stop (0,-690). Both pairs are inside 150 m. Optional: an S1 station over Circus Road at about x -360 would sit 200 m from Sphere Gardens, the minimum stationSpacing, and directly above T2. That would be a second interchange. Siting it is Vantage's call.

Kept unchanged (not listed): T1, the Boulevard trunk with its balloon loop round the circus island. This already covers tide's 'T1 through the circus'. Also kept: S1, the straight double trunk with its skyport loop. Running T1 on up Crown Avenue, and retiring the Sphere loop and the quay loop, are still open plan questions for Sky.

The two-way Sky Loop is still rejected under S-C1. At the ring corners an R70 fillet cuts about 29 m inside the corner point. A 24 m road's kerb corner is only about 17 m in, so the beam would pass over corner plots.

No speeds, timetables, fares or off-sheet destinations are set here. No source gives them, and timetables are Pulse's. Done-check: Vantage places the stops, then bun tools/plan/cli.ts must exit 0, with N-R1 passing for rocket-west.
